suites.name: test-client-mode-transition
suites.purpose: Verifies client lifecycle mode transitions, strict loopback boundaries (127.0.0.1, [::1], localhost), rejection of private RFC1918/link-local/spoofed origins for dev clients, dev-to-prod promotion requirements, and field independence.

suites.name: cross-client-refresh-matrix
suites.purpose: Verifies cross-client refresh token theft prevention, atomic Compare-and-Swap (CAS) token rotation, and 2000ms grace window concurrency handling.

suites.name: full-production-adversarial-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies production hardening against adversarial attack vectors including token replay, header spoofing, and privilege escalation.

suites.name: final-adversarial-gate
suites.purpose: Master 28-check adversarial security gate verifying multi-tenant isolation, scoped admin restrictions, CSRF, and CAS.

suites.name: direct-backend-access-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies direct Lambda Function URL isolation, public protocol endpoint accessibility (curl), and GATEWAY-1 through GATEWAY-5 conjunctive trust boundary.

suites.name: session-hijacking-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies session theft defense, password rotation session invalidation, account deactivation, and CSRF protection.

suites.name: oauth-transaction-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies multi-tab OAuth transaction isolation, state parameter CAS, and authorization code single-use guarantees.

suites.name: credential-compromise-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies blast radius containment when individual user or app admin credentials are leaked or compromised.

suites.name: cross-tenant-matrix
suites.purpose: Verifies multi-tenant database partitioning, ensuring tenant A credentials, users, and scoped admins cannot access tenant B resources.

suites.name: production-vs-development-suite
suites.purpose: Verifies production clients require HTTPS public FQDNs while development clients require strict loopback addresses.

suites.name: deployed-consumer-suite
suites.purpose: End-to-end integration tests verifying production IdP endpoints, discovery, JWKS, and real deployed consumer application integration.

suites.name: aws-dashboard-integration-suite
suites.purpose: Validates the deployed AWS Dashboard consumer client authorization code exchange, token lifecycle, and userinfo flow.

suites.name: test-app-management-auth
suites.purpose: Verifies application creation, mutation, and deletion require strict Super-Admin authentication, blocking unauthenticated, client credentials, user tokens, app-admin JWTs, and scoped admins.

suites.name: e2e-oidc-interop
suites.purpose: Verifies OpenID Connect discovery, RS256 token signing, JWKS publication, and standards compliance for downstream consumers.

suites.name: load-and-performance
suites.purpose: Benchmark suite measuring throughput and latency on OAuth hot paths (authorize, token, userinfo). Non-blocking for CI.

suites.name: test-production-config
suites.purpose: Local configuration validation suite. Informational.

suites.name: phase25-security-gate
suites.purpose: Historical phase 25 regression suite (subsumed by final-adversarial-gate). Informational.

suites.name: second-pass-security-suite
suites.purpose: Historical second pass audit suite. Informational.

suites.name: security-remediation-test
suites.purpose: Historical remediation regression checks. Informational.

suites.name: test-app-admin-security
suites.purpose: Verifies retirement (410 Gone) of legacy app-admin credential-relay endpoints, OAuth-based admin authorization via signed RS256 claims, tenant scoping, and Super-Admin provisioning.

suites.name: test-rate-limit-failure-modes
suites.purpose: Verifies rate limiter failure modes: Mongo fallback, fail-closed admin defense, and bounded emergency in-process limiter under dual-store outage.
